description: China Pollution Intensities is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Environment", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). The dataset provides water pollution intensities for Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) and Total Suspended Solids (TSS); air pollution intensities for dust, smoke and sulphur dioxide (SO2). The units of measurement for value of output are kilograms per 1000/RMB Yuan. The pollution intensities are at the 2-,3-, and 4-digit ISIC level. Coverage: China. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Environment. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
